Every field is a way,
Every way a field
Born to yield
Truth unconcealed.
So vistas open
In the day's veil
And paths lead on,
Ever availed.
As is the seal
Wont to entail
The opening of sight
And sense's portrayal,
Too the bird in flight
The wind regails -
The end all and be all
From Real to re-All.
